title: BDSM
summary: BDSM covers consensual practices involving bondage & discipline, dominance & submission, and sadism & masochism. It's about negotiated power, sensation and trust — not abuse.
key_points: Built on informed consent, negotiation, safe words and aftercare.
Any participant can stop at any time.
Frameworks include SSC (safe, sane, consensual) and RACK (risk-aware consensual kink).
answer_guidance: Explain neutrally and educationally. Stress consent, communication and safety; avoid graphic detail.
